add-column: The document and page-digest columns are nullable and default-free, a catalog-only addition to reader notes without a rewrite, under 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
add-constraint: The widened target-type and document-shape CHECKs are added NOT VALID without scanning existing notes, under 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout; the online phase validates them after the schema lock is released.
create-policy: The document-cleanup owner policies add catalog metadata to reader notes without reading rows, with DDL lock acquisition bounded by 1s and the statement by 5s.
create-trigger: The statement-level document cleanup trigger installs metadata on the entities table without scanning rows, under 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
